rows.title: Power on the installed machine: Plymouth river theme, then the greeter chain
rows.unprovable: the splash frame itself (its timing is not deterministic); the evidence is the installed theme and the greeter chain

checks.reason: the installed system selects the river Plymouth theme, not the default
the login screen is gtkgreet inside cage (greetd's command), recorded by the guest while the greeter was up

rows.title: Greeter: login box on the dark Runink wallpaper

checks.reason: the login screen is a dark, drawn scene: not black, not a flat placeholder, with a box and text on it

rows.title: After login: the room starts dark, the lamp comes up as it is traced (not Plasma, Weston or black)

checks.reason: a dark room that has something drawn in it (lamp, clock), which a black or crashed screen does not have
the user's session runs desk and not a leftover Plasma or Weston compositor

rows.title: Wait for the trace: the lit walnut desk, session log has room lines

checks.reason: the room became lit (warm wood and lamp light, a drawn scene) and is not the dark frame again; retried while the CPU trace runs
desk logged its room trace, so the pictures came from desk itself

checks.cmd: p=$(pgrep -u runink -x desk | head -1); echo $p > /tmp/rt-deskpid; ps -o stat= -p $p
checks.reason: desk is alive (not a zombie); its pid is remembered so a later restart (crash loop) shows

rows.title: Super+Enter: a foot window on paper

checks.reason: the middle of the desk changed and now holds a large light, low-colour area: the paper sheet a window sits on
the terminal process exists, so the key chord reached DEsk and DEsk started it

rows.title: notify-send typed in foot, then Super+N: the post box opens with a letter

checks.reason: keystrokes typed through QMP reached the foot shell, and notify-send exited 0, which it does only if a notification service answered on the session bus
Super+N changed the screen from the terminal frame and the result is still a drawn scene

rows.title: Super+D: the felt drawer with its things

checks.reason: the drawer drew over the previous frame and the frame is a rich scene, not a blank

rows.title: Super+A: the bookcase with binders; icons are pictures, not initials

checks.reason: the bookcase replaced the previous view and carries many colours (binders, sheets)
librsvg is in the image: without it every ALL APPS icon falls back to initials (gap G3)

rows.title: Type "term" in ALL APPS: the book searches

checks.reason: typing into the open book changed the page (the search filtered it) and the frame stays a drawn scene
the program the search should find is installed with a desktop entry

rows.title: Super+C: the Control Panel (meters, volume knob, levers, key)

checks.reason: the panel replaced the search page and is a drawn scene
the volume knob's backend (wpctl) is installed

rows.title: Volume: wpctl reports the changed value (PipeWire user service up, a sink present)
rows.unprovable: dragging the volume knob with the pointer (its position on the painted panel is not stable enough to aim at)

checks.reason: PipeWire's session manager runs in the user session and has a sink: the audio device QEMU gave the guest is usable
a volume set through the same wpctl DEsk's knob uses reads back changed

rows.title: Bluetooth lever opens bluetuith titled Bluetooth
rows.unprovable: the lever click (no stable position) and any controller (QEMU has none)

checks.reason: the program the lever starts and the helper that names it exist

rows.title: Tray row: nm-applet
rows.unprovable: the slip under the panel as drawn

checks.reason: the tray program is running in the user session

rows.title: Shell Settings, System tab: the Experience Index opens
rows.unprovable: opening Shell Settings and reading which rows are faint (gap G4 is a visual judgement)

checks.reason: the Experience Index program the System tab opens is installed

rows.title: Language ja and back: Japanese words, no tofu boxes
rows.unprovable: switching the language in Shell Settings and reading the result

checks.reason: a font with Japanese coverage is installed (Noto CJK): without it Japanese shows as boxes

rows.title: Weather opt-in: with the option off, nothing is sent to open-meteo.com
rows.unprovable: ticking the option and seeing rain at the door (needs the Settings click)

checks.reason: the guest's whole network capture so far (DNS names and TLS server names are in the clear) holds no weather host while the option is off

rows.title: Print: the camera, drag an area, Enter, a PNG in ~/Pictures/Screenshots

checks.reason: Print changed the screen (the camera put up to the eye)
a screenshot file exists
the file is a real PNG, not an empty or text file

rows.title: Shift+Print, shutter, Print: an mp4 in ~/Videos/Screencasts

checks.reason: Shift+Print changed the screen (the recording camera)

checks.cmd: f=$(ls -1t /home/runink/Videos/Screencasts/*.mp4 | head -1); ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$f"
checks.reason: the recording is a file ffprobe can read, with a duration

rows.title: Super+L: the front door with the brass plate

checks.reason: the whole view became another scene (the door), still a drawn one
the PAM service the door asks exists, so a typed password can be judged
desk is the same process as at the lit room: it has not crashed and restarted

rows.title: Wrong password: the key will not turn

checks.reason: the screen is still the door (not the room) after a wrong password, and still drawn
a wrong password did not end the session

rows.title: Right password: the door opens, the room is as it was left

checks.reason: the view is the room again, close to the frame taken before the door (windows as left); retried while the door swings
the terminal opened before the lock is still running

rows.title: Alt+Tab held: windows spread across the desk

checks.reason: there are two windows to switch between
holding Alt+Tab changed the screen against the frame before it (the spread)

rows.title: Super+Left, Super+Right: the window snaps to a half

checks.reason: after Super+Left the left half holds a large light window area
after Super+Right the right half holds it and the picture moved against the left-half frame

rows.title: Second head: the desk continues on screen 2
rows.unprovable: a new window opening on the pointer's screen (one pointer device spans both heads in QEMU)

checks.reason: the second display head shows something drawn: the session enabled its second output and DEsk painted on it

rows.title: Session ends (elogind), the greeter returns (greetd restarts it)
rows.unprovable: the LOG OUT lever and DEsk asking its windows to close (the session is ended with loginctl terminate-user)

checks.reason: greetd started the greeter again after the session ended
desk is gone with the session
the screen shows the login screen again

rows.title: Log in again: the desk is back fast (cache hit), no trace letter

checks.reason: desk started for the second session
the lit room is on screen again within a minute: the room came from the cache, not a minutes-long CPU trace
the room cache exists in the user's home

rows.title: Ctrl+Alt+Del twice: the desk redraws, windows stay

checks.reason: the reset redrew inside the same desk process, not a restart of the session
the window opened before the reset is still there
the room is lit again after the redraw

rows.title: Battery low: the letter at 15% and 5%
rows.hardware: QEMU has no battery. river-desk battery is covered by table-driven tests on a fixture power_supply directory (installer/desk, run by CI's installer-go); a real laptop shows the letter.

rows.title: USB stick put in: mounted, a letter in the post box
rows.unprovable: the letter in the post box and Thunar listing the stick (on-screen content)

checks.reason: the hot-plugged stick was mounted by the session's automount (river-desk and udisks2) with no one clicking

rows.title: loginctl poweroff: the VM powers off through elogind

checks.reason: QEMU reported SHUTDOWN or exited: the guest powered itself off through elogind (no systemctl)

rows.title: Brightness keys change the panel backlight
rows.hardware: needs logind SetBrightness on a real panel; QEMU has no backlight device

rows.title: AIRPLANE, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi levers (rfkill)
rows.hardware: QEMU has no radios and no rfkill switches

rows.title: Lid close, suspend and resume
rows.hardware: needs real ACPI sleep states and a lid switch

rows.title: Touch screen: tap, drag, pinch
rows.hardware: needs a touch panel; QEMU's tablet is a pointer, not multi-touch

rows.title: Pen: pressure, eraser, handwriting
Auto-rotate from the accelerometer
rows.hardware: needs an accelerometer (iio-sensor-proxy has nothing to read in QEMU)

rows.title: Room ray trace in 6-9 seconds on a real GPU
rows.hardware: needs a Radeon or Intel GPU with a driver; the QEMU guest draws on the processor (2D Fallback)
